result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk in poor condition with visible debris and cracking. No crossing infrastructure, lighting, or traffic calming measures are visible in the immediate vicinity.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Large chunks of concrete or stone are sitting on the sidewalk, creating a tripping hazard and narrowing the usable path.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, which can be hazardous for those with mobility impairments.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the cracked sidewalk surface and remove all debris to ensure a clear, level path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway and improve the pedestrian experience.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban street lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs. A large truck parked near the intersection creates a significant visual obstruction, further reducing safety for those attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Truck
hazards.description: A large truck parked near the corner on the left side of the image blocks sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, near the foreground intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the junction.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the two streets in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection and install curb extensions to improve sightlines and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with active utility construction in the roadway, creating a significant physical hazard for all road users. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there is a notable lack of formal crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Active Roadway Excavation
hazards.description: A large hole and pile of debris in the center of the street with minimal protection for pedestrians navigating the area.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing points for pedestrians at the intersection, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and construction equipment block sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of street and background

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Provide a clearly marked and protected path for pedestrians to navigate around the construction site safely.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street environment is characterized by a lack of basic pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and a continuous sidewalk network on both sides of the road. The wide, unmarked pavement and poor surface condition suggest a low-priority area for pedestrian safety despite the residential context.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, increasing exposure risk for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows significant cracking and patching, which can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide, unmarked residential street.
